reference: Six-model stoppage consensus, protected in data/control_dynamics_v1 with pre-round source and ledger archives.
feedback_loop: Selected buffered seed42 short possessions matched at IoU>=.5:3/6; require>=4 and substantial primary gain. The pre-round diagnostic was run and failed.
ranked_hypotheses: Ball tracking outliers distort proximity. Fixed local trajectory repair should improve nearest-team correctness before model fitting, especially on the missed short controls.
A touch changes ball velocity, while a nearby flying ball need not. Before/after velocity and distance-weighted impulse features may provide ownership evidence absent from nearest-distance summaries.

Brief impulse events need bounded past/future memory to explain ownership between touches. These event summaries may improve the live-only head and recover short proposals without replacing the selected stoppage heads.
data: Existing local tactical tracking and metadata, public GT only for eligible training/scoring, unchanged padded prefix18935 and all frozen train/validation indices. No media, private labels, annotations, uploads or final frame patches.

trajectory.median: Linearly fill only whole gaps<=5frames between finite endpoints, then centered7 coordinate median with>=3 points. Preserve original observed center if unavailable; unsupported missing centers remain missing.
trajectory.robust: Centered25 local linear regression per coordinate, Gaussian temporal weights sigma6frames, three Huber reweighting passes at radial residual2metres. Require>=5 observed points and nonsingular fit; preserve original observed center if unavailable. Missing centers are filled only inside whole observed-bracket gaps<=13frames. No long-gap interpolation.
trajectory.geometry: Per team corrected-ball distances to closest3 players, closest player's supplied speed, counts within1/3/5metres, distance advantage/control share; corrected-ball speed and displacement over5frames; original-vs-repaired distance and observed flags. No absolute coordinates enter the model.
trajectory.impulses: Velocities from repaired ball5frames before/after center, clip invalid speeds>80m/s; vector impulse magnitude, turn cosine, before/after speed. Team impulse strength=exp(-.5*(nearest_distance/2)^2)*clip(impulse/10,0,1). Add past/future max over25/75frames and mean over13/25frames. Context stays within125frames including repair and velocity kernels.

models.ordered_control: Existing ordered inputs, unchanged fit_control settings; matched representation control.
models.impulse_control: Ordered inputs plus robust geometry and impulse/memory features.

screen.training: Existing fit_control binary live-only XGBoost:depth2,160trees,learning_rate.04,lambda10,min_child15,subsample.8,colsample.9,n_jobs2; team augmentation and symmetrized prediction. Read targets only at eligible training live indices; no early stopping, preprocessing fit or calibration.
screen.replace_fast: Use the new head in the unchanged six-model canonical stoppage decoder, keeping the ordered/previous/D heads and all gates fixed.
screen.short_proposals: Keep selected reference D mask. Use existing ownership_prediction short_proposals with new head and contact_support from the corresponding repaired geometry; ordered control uses original support. No phase support. Confidence>=.65, runs8..125, opposite reference flanks,>=3 contact-supported frames and no referenceD overlap. All gates read unchanged reference.
screen.replace_live: Existing ownership_prediction replace_live: keep referenceD mask exactly, decode each live segment with centered11 new-head probabilities and penalty3.

confirmation: Freeze at most one unchanged finalist before seeds43/44 across all protocols. No thresholds or feature changes after confirmation. If none passes seed42 screen retain current selection and record failures.

promotion.all_pairs: No primary regression; MacroF1>=reference-.005; D recall>=reference-.02; no additional mostly missed stoppages; no previously mostly recovered short run becomes mostly missed; falseD<=reference+10frames.
promotion.substantial: Buffered primary gain>=.04 for each seed; positive mean primary gain for each other protocol; improved short mean best IoU; at least one additional buffered short IoU>=.5 match.
promotion.selection: Largest minimum primary gain across protocols, then mean short IoU. Record all block regressions. Full reproducible CSV, official scoring, source/cache/model parity and independent code review required before promotion.

interpretation: Adaptive same-match development on17 repeatedly inspected public possessions. Filters are observation-only and their parameters are fixed before scoring; nearest-team diagnostics are not the target possession score or independent validation. No maximum/private accuracy claim.
